title: コンピュータシステム
subtitle: Computer System
educationalGoal: Information technology (IT) is an indispensable part of modern society, and it is realized by computer systems. In this course, students will learn the structure and operating principles of a central processing unit (CPU), memory, and the input/output units that are the main components of a computer. In addition, students will learn about other computer components, system components, software, and hardware.
advice: This course covers the following basics of computer systems: 1. Computer components 2. Principles of calculation, instruction execution control 3. Assembler language 4. Configuration of storage devices and memory 5. Calculation methods for performance evaluation
requiredKnowledge: This is the first course covering the internal structure of computers. Students should review numerical expressions such as binary.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand the components of a computer
Be able to understand programs written in the assembler language.
Be able to explain calculation control.
Be able to understand the configuration of memory.
Be able to understand basic properties of an operating system.
